description: On a dynaset over W with held Fields ID, Db and Mm, at row 1: (a) Edit, assign Db 99.5 and Mm "edited memo" without Update, GetRows(0), read EditMode and ID, GetRows(1), read EditMode, ID, Db and Mm, CancelUpdate, Errors, EditMode, MoveFirst, read Db and Mm. (b) AddNew, assign ID 7, Db 7.5 and Mm "added", GetRows(3), read EditMode, ID, Db, GetRows(1), CancelUpdate, Errors, EditMode, RecordCount. (c) MoveFirst, Edit, assign Db 55.5 and Mm "m3", GetRows(3), CancelUpdate, MoveFirst, read Db and Mm. Asks whether GetRows returns buffer or stored values for the row being edited, what it does to the pending edit and to the current row, and its result for an AddNew buffer. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
